order: Change the guard's default behavior for an undetermined model from enforcing to standing down. Today, when the transcript has no assistant entry yet — notably a brand-new session's very first turn — the guard treats the undetermined state as if it belonged to a director model and blocks basic tools, forcing a fresh session into unnecessary delegation before it has done anything. Require positive evidence of a director model in the transcript before enforcing, so plain sessions never see a denial, including on their first turn. Accept that a genuine director session pays a one-turn cost — a single unenforced opening turn — before hard enforcement engages as soon as the model appears in the transcript, and confirm the existing delegation instructions already cover that gap. Update the docs describing mode detection and troubleshooting to match the corrected default.
claims: The guard now requires positive evidence of a director model before enforcing; sessions without one — including a fresh session's first turn — never see a denial. A genuine director session absorbs one unenforced opening turn before hard enforcement engages as soon as the model reaches the transcript, which the existing delegation instructions already cover. Docs on mode detection and troubleshooting were updated to match.
